svg.title: Bias can enter at every stage—measure and mitigate it
svg.desc: Bias can enter through data selection and representation, learned model associations, or deployment framing and feedback loops. Mitigate at data, training, alignment, and inference stages. StereoSet reports LMS and SS and combines them with ICAT; Regard measures social perception.

g.text: Bias can enter at every stage—measure and mitigate it
There is no simply “unbiased” model; document and monitor risks in context.
Names · completions · preferences → report metrics, document limits, monitor deployment.
